checked_obligation: Verify that any single removed horizontal or vertical three-stamp block hits at most fourteen potential triples.
reason: For a horizontal block in columns j,j+1,j+2, any intersecting horizontal triple must start between j-2 and j+2, giving at most five. Each removed cell belongs to at most three vertical triples, and the three cells lie in distinct columns, giving at most nine distinct vertical triples. Thus at most 5+9=14 triples are hit; the vertical case follows symmetrically. No external theorem or listed group-theoretic rule is invoked or applicable.
